# HMP Poll: Leela Gray LEADS Anna Paulina Luna in FL-13

September 1, 2026

Washington, D.C. – A new House Majority PAC poll of Florida’s 13th Congressional District, conducted by Hart Research Associates from August 25-27, finds Democratic candidate Leela Gray leading Republican candidate Anna Paulina Luna, 51% to 46%.

Key findings from HMP’s poll include: [...] Leela Gray leads Anna Paulina Luna in the multi-candidate ballot: In an initial multi-candidate matchup, Gray leads Luna 44% to 43%. 7% said they would support independent candidate Tony D’Arrigo.
 Democrats lead on the generic congressional ballot: 49% of FL-13 voters say they would support
results.title: HMP Poll: Leela Gray LEADS Anna Paulina Luna in FL-13

results.content:
According to recent Emerson College polling, 51% of voters support the Democratic candidate on a generic ballot. A Reuters/Ipsos poll shows that 42% of registered voters would vote for a Democratic congressional candidate, versus 37% who would vote Republican.

These are signs the party is on the mend. And although Democrats could be doing even better if the party had been campaigning throughout the past two years, now is not the time to stop caring. [...] The shifts we’re seeing within the Democratic Party mean absolutely nothing if there is no follow-through. Regardless of whom you voted for in the primary, it is imperative that we all head to the polls this fall with one goal in mind: win
